briefTitle: FIH Trial of VERT-002 in Patients With Locally Advanced or Metastatic Solid Tumors With MET Alterations

typedChecks.sourceText: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.
typedChecks.evidence_quote: Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) performance status 0 or 1.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 1: histological confirmation of relapsed and/or refractory locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor for which no standard of care treatment is available.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Part 1 includes general solid tumors rather than being limited exclusively to NSCLC.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 1: presence of at least one of the following MET alterations based on local documentation of blood or archived tissue results: METex14 mutation, MET kinase domain activating gene mutations (e.g. H1094L/R/Y, D1228H/N/V, Y1230A/C/D/H), MET amplification
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: There are no dedicated typed checks for MET alterations or MET amplification.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 2-a: presence of METex14 mutation (based on local documentation of blood or archived tissue results) and for Part 2-b presence of at least one of the following MET alterations: METex14 mutation (based on local documentation of blood or archived tissue results), de novo MET amplification (based on local documentation of archived tissue results). Confirmation after enrollment in the trial will be performed by central testing from an archival tumor biopsy sample (either tissue block or at least 15 serial cut unstained slides of 5 μm, at least 20% tumor content). In case no archival biopsy is available for central testing, the patient must be willing to have a fresh tumor biopsy sample collected and the tumor biopsy should be deemed safe and feasible by the investigator.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex criteria involving optional fresh biopsy feasibility, central testing requirements, and multiple conditional MET alteration sub-parts.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 2: at least one measurable target lesion according to RECIST v1.1.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Measurable disease by RECIST is a subjective imaging judgment, not a typed kind.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 2: a maximum of 3 prior lines of systemic therapies.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Part-specific prior lines limit cannot be combined into a single study-wide rule without part distinction.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Adequate hematologic function. Adequate hepatic function. Adequate renal function. Albumin ≥ 3 g/dL. Adequate coagulation function. Adequate cardiac function.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: General organ function categories without specific numeric cutoffs for labs except albumin.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Uncontrolled Central Nervous System (CNS) metastases or spinal cord compression that are associated with progressive neurological symptoms or require increasing doses of corticosteroids to control the CNS disease.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Excludes uncontrolled CNS metastases with progressive symptoms or increasing steroids, which does not fit a simple standard allowedBrainMets category.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part 2: histological confirmation of locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC Stage IIIB/C or IV (American Joint Commission on Cancer [AJCC] 8th edition) in participants who are not eligible for or should have received available standard of care therapies including curative intent surgery, chemoradiation, radiotherapy or systemic therapy.
